title: Burst skills
summary: Fuelled by the Burst gauge, which fills on Perfect Dodges.

sections.note: SP comes from first clears. A skill can be learned once the skill it requires is learned.
rows: Unleashes a devastating storm of blades with the power of Burst Energy.

Tempest
